These CORE requirements have no task covering them yet (a task covers a requirement by listing its id in requirement_ids):
- R-001: Voice recording with live waveform view while recording
- R-002: Recording survives a phone call interruption and finalizes/resumes without corruption or data loss
- R-003: Recording survives a Siri invocation interruption and finalizes/resumes without corruption or data loss
- R-004: Recording survives app backgrounding and finalizes/resumes without corruption or data loss
- R-005: Recording survives a force-quit via app switcher during active recording without corrupting the in-progress entry
- R-006: Recording survives a route change (e.g. headphone/AirPods disconnect) without silent clipping/corruption
- R-007: Interruption handling is implemented as an explicit reentrant state machine (idle/recording/interrupted/finalizing), not a boolean flag, and treats .interruption and .routeChange as distinct event types
- R-008: Transcription uses on-device Speech recognition only; never falls back to server-based recognition
- R-009: When on-device recognition is unsupported for the current locale/device, recording stays enabled and an explicit 'unavailable' state is shown
- R-010: Transcription status model has three distinct states: ready / on-device model downloading / unavailable
- R-011: Transcript text is editable after the fact
- R-012: Tapping a transcript sentence seeks the audio to that point, resolved via immutable anchor ID never raw string/character index
- R-013: Transcript anchors are immutable once created; user edits are represented as overlay deltas on top of the anchor set
- R-014: Tap-to-seek resolves correctly (<=300ms tolerance) after a transcript text edit
- R-016: NaturalLanguage-based tag suggestions are generated per transcript

Re-emit a SINGLE corrected ```tasks-json``` fenced block — the whole backlog, not a diff — that adds or updates tasks (via requirement_ids) so every one of these is covered by at least one task.
MACHINE CONTRACT (required): in your wrap-up, alongside the prose, emit ONE fenced ```tasks-json``` block containing a single JSON object of the form {"tasks": [{"id": "T-001", "title": ..., "owner_lane": ..., "files": [...], "depends_on": [], "acceptance_criteria": [...], "requirement_ids": ["R-001"], "status": "pending"}]}. owner_lane must be one of: data_domain, primary_ui, services_utilities, polish_resilience. depends_on lists task ids and the graph must be acyclic. requirement_ids lists the id(s) from requirements.json this task fulfills — every CORE requirement needs at least one task naming it, or the build is missing part of what was promised. The build workers are assigned their lane's tasks from this block, so make it complete.
